description:
Direct Supply is building the future of healthcare technology with industry-leading products, solutions and platforms to help improve the lives of millions of seniors and those who care for them.    
   
 As a Software Engineer, you’ll build and enhance scalable applications that improve customer experiences and support Direct Supply’s technology solutions. You’ll apply modern software engineering practices, AI capabilities, and automation to create reliable, secure, and efficient products that solve real business problems.   
   
 Working alongside cross-functional teams, you’ll contribute to web, mobile, and server-based solutions while exploring practical ways to integrate AI into applications and development workflows. Your work will help accelerate innovation, improve development efficiency, and deliver technology that creates measurable value for customers and Partners.   
   
 What You’ll Do and Impact:    
 Develop secure, scalable web, mobile, and server-based applications that deliver reliable functionality and improve customer experiences.   
 Build and integrate AI-powered features, including conversational assistants, intelligent automation, and image-based capabilities, to solve customer and business challenges.   
 Design and implement APIs and microservices that enable reliable data exchange and integration across applications and systems.   
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop AI-enabled solutions that simplify customer interactions and improve operational efficiency.   
 Apply AI-assisted development tools and automation to improve coding efficiency, accelerate testing, and maintain software quality.   
 Monitor application performance, reliability, and AI-generated outputs to identify issues and support continuous improvement.   
 Prototype and test new features and AI capabilities to evaluate feasibility, usability, and business value before broader implementation.   
 Troubleshoot application defects and technical issues to improve system stability, performance, and user satisfaction.   
 Implement software testing, security, and development standards to maintain code quality and reduce operational risk.   
 Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical improvements that enhance application functionality and development productivity.   
   
 What You'll Bring:   
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.   
 1–3 years of software engineering experience developing, testing, and maintaining applications.   
 Proficiency in Python, JavaScript (Node.js/React), C#, and MVC frameworks to develop reliable, scalable software solutions.   
 Experience integrating AI capabilities into applications using open-source models or APIs, such as Hugging Face, OpenAI, or Anthropic.   
 Experience designing and consuming APIs, working with databases, and developing applications using modern software engineering practices.   
 Familiarity with Microsoft development tools, including Visual Studio or VS Code, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.   
 Ability to apply Agile development practices, Git version control, and testing approaches to deliver high-quality software.   
 Demonstrated ability to analyze technical problems, learn emerging technologies, and collaborate across teams to implement practical solutions that meet business and customer needs. 
 Job to be performed in the location listed. Generous benefit package available.
